title.narrative: Champions Without Barriers: Strengthening Leadership and Life Skills of Adolescents Through Football

description.narrative: Champions Without Barriers strengthens the leadership and life skills of adolescent girls through football, ensuring equal opportunities in three districts of Metropolitan Lima. The project creates safe spaces on and off the field, fostering self-esteem, agency, and informed decision-making. It follows three key strategies. First, collaboration, engaging communities, government agencies, and sports organizations to form 10 teams of at least 15 girls each. Second, capacity building, training local leaders—including amateur athletes and teachers—through a 16-week program to become coaches who promote safe environments. Finally, an inter-district league will combine football matches with leadership and life skills activities, ensuring lasting impact beyond the field.
